title: Move quote-bearing staged review out of inline PowerShell
failure_signature: An inline PowerShell staged-review command failed to parse an embedded quote-bearing privacy regex before Git staging ran.
trigger_preconditions: Exact staged review combines Python regex syntax with Windows PowerShell string parsing.
candidate_workaround: Use a dedicated UTF-8 Python runner with explicit staged-blob, manifest, JSON, diff-hygiene, and scanner-definition domains.
recurrence_guard: Do not embed quote-bearing privacy regexes inside a PowerShell inline Python string.
rollback: Retain the parser fault, confirm the index is unchanged, and stage only after the dedicated runner and manifest are current.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-scoped staged review only; zero hits is not complete privacy assurance.
